title: Solar Apocalypse Advanced
description: Sun is going to roast all over the world and your main goal is to survive.
body:
"The sun is roasting the world and your main goal is to survive. Go underground and start a new life." In this minecraft modpack The sun is getting bigger and roasting all over the world and the main objective is basicly surviving. You can farm, grind, build and explore if you can.
It has many Qol mods.

**The Hardcore Feeling**
  - Mobs Difficulty Gets Increased Over Time.
  - thousands of mob variants
  - Hardcore Reviving System If Playing With Friends.
  - The Thirst bar

**Building | Furniture Features**
  - Macaws Furnitures
  - Better Block Placing Improvements

**Adventure Features**
  - Many Backpacks
  - New Buildings & Underground buildings

**Surviving Feeling**
  - New Plants & Foods To Save From Sun Apocalypse.
  - Storage Mods

**Grinding & Mining**
  - New Ores
  - Advanced Netherite
  - New Foods And Variants

**FPS Features**
  - Many Fps Boost Mods.
  - Reduces Source Usage When Not Using
  - Light Mods
